# Clinical Substitute Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: substitute_item_id, equivalency_class, exception_id.

# Substitution Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-OE-108
Item: INFUSION-PUMP-ACCESSORY-30
Quantity: 30
Target unit price: 74.00
Required terms_json keys: substitute_item_id, equivalency_class, exception_id.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include substitute_item_id, equivalency_class, exception_id inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
substitute_item_id: INFUSION-PUMP-ACCESSORY-30B
equivalency_class: clinical_equivalent_a
exception_id: PINE-EXC-2026-108
